name: pick
eval: (async()=>{try{return await (async()=>{const bs=()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('#campaign-builder button')];{const b=bs().find(b=>/western$/.test(b.textContent));if(!b.textContent.startsWith('■'))b.click()};await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300));{const b=bs().find(b=>/cosmic-horror$/.test(b.textContent));if(!b.textContent.startsWith('■'))b.click()};await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300));const ta=document.querySelectorAll('#campaign-builder textarea');ta[0].value='A dust-choked frontier town where the mine has broken into something older than the stars; the sheriff is missing and the church bell rings by itself at night.';ta[0].dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));ta[1].value='Keep ammo scarce and let the townsfolk hide secrets.';ta[1].dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));const sel=[...document.querySelectorAll('#campaign-builder button')].filter(b=>b.textContent.startsWith('■')).map(b=>b.textContent);if(!sel.some(t=>/western/.test(t))||!sel.some(t=>/cosmic-horror/.test(t)))throw new Error('STEP picker: '+sel);return sel.join(',')})()}catch(e){return 'THROWN '+e.message}})()

name: main-character+party
eval: (async()=>{try{const W=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const ta=[...document.querySelectorAll('#campaign-builder textarea')].find(t=>/main character/.test(t.placeholder||''));if(!ta)throw new Error('STEP main-character: field missing');ta.value='Wren Calloway, a scout who rode in after her brother vanished down the mine';ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('#campaign-builder button')].find(b=>/Yes, a party/.test(b.textContent));if(!b)throw new Error('STEP party: buttons missing');b.click();await W(400);const sel=[...document.querySelectorAll('#campaign-builder button')].find(b=>/Yes, a party/.test(b.textContent)).textContent;if(!sel.startsWith('\u25a0'))throw new Error('STEP party: not selected');return 'mc set; '+sel}catch(e){return 'THROWN '+e.message}})()

name: start-world
eval: (async()=>{try{return await (async()=>{const W=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));[...document.querySelectorAll('#campaign-builder button')].find(b=>/Start this world/.test(b.textContent)).click();await W(900);const s=document.getElementById('cb-status')?.textContent||'';if(!/Started/.test(s))throw new Error('STEP start-world failed: '+s);return s+' HB='+HolodekFlags.HOMEBREW_ACTIVE})()}catch(e){return 'THROWN '+e.message}})()

name: menu-has-no-premades
eval: (async()=>{try{return await (async()=>{const W=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const say=async t=>{const i=document.getElementById('chatuserinput');i.value=t;await chatbotprocessinput();await W(1500)};await W(2000);const t=document.getElementById('chatlog').innerText.slice(-400);if(/Suzerain|Mortacia/.test(t)||!/3\) Create character/.test(t))throw new Error('STEP menu: '+t.slice(-200));await say('2');return document.getElementById('chatlog').innerText.slice(-200)})()}catch(e){return 'THROWN '+e.message}})()

name: create
eval: (async()=>{try{return await (async()=>{const W=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const say=async t=>{const i=document.getElementById('chatuserinput');i.value=t;await chatbotprocessinput();await W(1500)};for(const a of ['Wren Calloway','Female','1','1',''])await say(a);await W(4000);const b=document.getElementById('review-save-button');return 'review='+!!b+' '+(document.body.innerText.match(/Wren Calloway[\s\S]{0,200}/)||[''])[0].replace(/\n/g,' | ')})()}catch(e){return 'THROWN '+e.message}})()

name: save
eval: (async()=>{try{const W=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const t0=Date.now();document.getElementById('review-save-button')?.click();let n=0,room='';for(let i=0;i<180;i++){await W(1000);const pop=document.getElementById('review-save-button');if(pop&&pop.offsetParent)n++;const slot=document.getElementById('room-art-slot');const m=(slot?.parentElement?.innerText||'').match(/Room:\s*([^\n]+)/);if(m&&!/still writing|^First Room$/.test(m[1])&&!(pop&&pop.offsetParent)){room=m[1];break;}}const log=document.getElementById('chatlog').innerText;if(/Could not start the game|signal timed out/i.test(log))throw new Error('STEP save: '+(log.match(/(Could not start|signal timed out)[^\n]*/i)||[''])[0]);if(!room)throw new Error('STEP first-room: no room after '+(Date.now()-t0)/1000+'s');if(/Ruined Temple/.test(room))throw new Error('STEP first-room: fell back to CotG '+room+' CTX '+(document.getElementById('room-art-slot')?.parentElement?.innerText||'').slice(0,600)+' T='+(Date.now()-t0));await W(15000);const where=[...document.querySelectorAll('body *')].filter(e=>/Room:\s*Ruined Temple Entrance/.test(e.textContent)).map(e=>(e.id||e.tagName)+':'+getComputedStyle(e).display+':'+e.textContent.slice(0,80));return JSON.stringify({where,secs:(Date.now()-t0)/1000,room,popupVisibleSecsAfterSave:n,popupNow:!!document.getElementById('review-save-button')?.offsetParent,illu:/illustration unavailable/i.test(document.body.innerText)})}catch(e){return 'THROWN '+e.message}})()

name: checks
eval: (async()=>{try{return await (async()=>{const f=await (await fetch('/world1-flags')).json();const gc=document.getElementById('game-console')?.innerText||'';const log=document.getElementById('chatlog').innerText;const all=(document.getElementById('game-console')?.innerText||'')+log.slice(log.lastIndexOf('Step 1: Enter character name'));const o={res:f.RESOURCE_NAME,luck:/Luck:/.test(all),magicInSheet:/Magic:/.test(document.querySelector('.character-table')?.innerText||''),cotg:(all.match(/.{0,80}(Tartarus|Ruined Temple|Suzerain|Mortacia|Atinus|Grave Master).{0,40}/g)||[]),gm:f.GM_NAME};if(o.cotg.length)throw new Error('STEP checks: CotG leak '+o.cotg.join(' / '));if(!o.luck)throw new Error('STEP checks: Luck: not shown');return JSON.stringify(o)})()}catch(e){return 'THROWN '+e.message}})()
